verdict.rationale: Fathom's pricing page claims its own "CRM field sync, updating records after meetings automatically" plus a "Deal View", and the webhook API exposes an `include_crm_matches` option, which implies first-party matching of meetings to CRM records. The evidence is only a few marketing lines, though. It never names supported CRMs or explains how notes and summaries land on the right contact and deal records. missing for 10: named support for HubSpot, Salesforce and Attio, documentation of contact- and deal-level record association and what content syncs (notes and summaries), independent or hands-on corroboration.
